newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Nor'Wester cut to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Nor'Wester cut to sell.

text.p: -- Jensen Securities said it cut its rating to sell from underperform "as it now appears the cash flow problems facing the company are much more severe than previously expected."
-- Estimates the craft brewer will lose $1.75 a share in fiscal 1997 compared with a loss of $0.80 in 1996, excluding possible one-time charges relative to plant closures.

-- Analyst Steven Dietrich said company faces intense competition within segment, a negative working capital position, expired bank revolving credit, and significantly overdue accounts payable. It also said the company's plan to merge with affiliate breweries and sell equity to the UB Group will substantially dilute existing Nor'Wester shareholders.
-- "We believe (the UB merger) represents the consolidation phase of an industry shake out that will benefit well-capitalized craft brewers like Redhook Ale Brewery Inc," he said.
